# ARZ Construction Ltd

> ARZ Construction Ltd is a construction company serving Croydon, Bromley and South London. It delivers loft conversions, house extensions, full house renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, electrical, plumbing, roofing, plastering, tiling and decorating for homeowners. Free, itemised written quotes are returned within 24 hours.

## Key facts — direct answers

- What does ARZ Construction Ltd do? Loft conversions, house extensions, full renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, electrical, plumbing, roofing, plastering, tiling and decorating across Croydon, Bromley and South London.
- How much does a loft conversion cost in Croydon (2026)? Rooflight conversions £25,000–£35,000; rear dormer on a semi-detached house £40,000–£55,000; hip-to-gable with rear dormer £45,000–£65,000. An en-suite adds roughly £6,000–£12,000.
- How much does a house extension cost in Croydon? Rear, side-return and wrap-around house extensions from £45,000, quoted as one fixed price.
- How long does a loft conversion take? A standard dormer takes 8–12 weeks on site; adding a hip-to-gable typically extends the programme by 2–3 weeks.
- Do you need planning permission for a loft conversion in Croydon? Most fall under permitted development (up to 40m³ additional roof volume for terraced houses, 50m³ for semi-detached and detached). Full planning permission is required in conservation areas, for listed buildings, or when the volume limits are exceeded. ARZ assesses this at the first survey and handles any application.
- Is a party wall agreement needed? Dormer and hip-to-gable steelwork usually bears on the party wall, so the Party Wall etc. Act 1996 applies; extensions also require notice when foundations are dug within 3m of a neighbour's building and deeper than its foundations (6m for deeper footings). Notice periods: two months for work on the party wall, one month for adjacent excavation or a new boundary wall. ARZ serves the notices and manages the process.
- Does a loft conversion add value? Local estate agents commonly estimate a finished conversion adds 15–25% to South London property values and avoids stamp duty, legal fees and moving costs.
- How do I get a quote? Call or WhatsApp +44 7860 135189 or use the contact form; a free survey is followed by a written, itemised quotation within 24 hours.

- [Decorating](https://www.arzconstructionltd.com/services/decorating): interior and exterior painting and decorating.
